The cork had swollen tight. Inside was a single sheet, brittle and folded small, written in pencil. He carried it up the spiral stairs and read it beneath the lamp. The writer was a girl named Ines, who had thrown it from a ferry thirty years earlier. She asked only that whoever found it light a candle for her father, who had worked this coast. Tomas looked at the great lamp turning above him. Then he struck a match, lit a small candle on the sill, and watched it burn until morning.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡的街口投下一圈圈昏黄的光，像是替夜晚守着最后的秘密。远处传来清洁车缓慢的扫地声，沙沙作响。早点铺的卷帘门刚刚拉起，蒸笼里冒出白色的热气，带着面粉和豆浆的香味。高楼的窗户大多还黑着，只有几盏灯亮着，那是加班的人和失眠的人。天边还没有一丝亮色，空气里已有一点凉意，整座城市仿佛屏住呼吸，等待第一班地铁驶过。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job solves itself by handing a smaller copy of the same job to itself.\n- It's like Russian nesting dolls: you open one and find a smaller doll, again and again, until you reach the tiny one that doesn't open.\n- That tiny doll is the stopping point, so the opening ends and you can finish all the jobs back out."}
